paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov bar Giyori — Eruvin 62a. In Yuchasin, the form Rabbi Yaakov son of Rav Giyori is copied from Moed Katan 18a; Hyman’s Gemara reading, however, is “bar Giyori.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman contrasts “son of Rav Giyori” with “bar Giyori.”

Eruvin 62a names Rabbi Yitzchak be-Rabbi Yaakov bar Giyorei; Moed Katan 18a names Rav Yitzchak bar Yaakov bar Giyorei. Hyman’s separate Yuchasin report is retained without harmonizing the contextual title forms.
